scope: Post-seal sensitivity analysis of physical candidate ownership on natural170/171 only. Motivated by observed zero dual coverage at unique oriented IoU > 0.25. All 168 natural directions remain in study, both-endpoint statistics on all independently traceable 42. No changes to predictions, candidate pools, thresholds, or model.
reference_owner: Exact archived R171 shared seed/label point-membership rule, pre-existing thresholds. Require at least two observed seeds, unique seed GT membership, >=55% support to the winner and >=15% lead over every alternative including background. No current method used this information.
conditions: original and two coherent role lists
original A256 and coherent A256 geometric unions
v1, mirror method, independent role marginals, matched random correspondence, weighted box fusion
endpoints: Use the same recovered natural human endpoint identities for both rules. Count all four simultaneous-availability categories, known single endpoint and both-correct, per case, method, direction and panel. Checking cross-rule agreement is descriptive, not selection of the better-looking evaluator.
